newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritian rupee weakens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Mauritian rupee weakens against dollar.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against the dollar and and the pound on Friday, reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was quoted at a commercial mean rate of 20.6335 to the dollar from 20.6165 on Thursday and at a commercial mean rate of 33.6925 against the pound from 33.6625 on Thursday.
Forex dealers said both dollar and the pound were still strong against other currencies on international markets.
On the local market some commercial banks were in hard currency shortage positions and were waiting central bank intervention to meet importers' demand, dealers said.
